title: HN Match — Hacker News Job Matchmaking
excerpt: AI-powered matching between HN candidates and job postings
content_html:
September 2026 · Hacker News

Find your match on HN

AI-powered matchmaking between “Who is Hiring” job postings and “Who Wants to Be Hired” candidates. Every match is pre-scored and broken down by signals.

Data sourced from Who is Hiring and Who Wants to Be Hired threads. Match scores are pre-computed using skill, domain, seniority, and salary overlap.
